newsitem.title: USA: Miami Computer president has 5.7 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Miami Computer president has 5.7 pct stake.

text.p: Miami Computer Supply Corp. President Albert Schwarz said Wednesday he and a limited partnership he controls have acquired 194,055 common shares of his company, or 5.73 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Schwaz said the stake was acquired for investment purposes.

Schwarz, who is also a director of the Dayton, Ohio, computer and office automation supplies distributor, said his stake includes 18,055 shares that he acquired in the company's initial public offering on Nov. 12.
